```{webr-r}
#| context: setup
# Shared, hidden data loader.
# Included at the top of any page that uses a dataset:  {{< include /_data-setup.qmd >}}
# Runs once, silently, on page load and copies the site's CSVs into webR's
# in-browser file system so chunks can open them by name, e.g. read_csv("capsules.csv").
#
# To add a new dataset: drop the CSV in assets/data/ and add its filename below.
local({
  base  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CPDSE-EDUX/R_documentation/refs/heads/main/assets/data/"
  files <- c("capsules.csv", "dissolution_data_raw.csv")
  for (f in files) download.file(paste0(base, f), f)
})
```
